text: We evaluated a contrastive-consistency probe on the strong model's hidden states using the ANLI testbed, measuring performance gap recovered (PGR) across num_seeds = 3 seeds. The observed PGR was 0.82 with a standard error of 0.16. No baseline PGR was provided in the data, so we cannot characterize this number as an improvement over any comparison method; it should be read only as a standalone estimate of how much of the weak-to-strong performance gap the probe recovers on this testbed. The sample of three seeds is small, and the standard error of 0.16 is substantial relative to the point estimate, so the true value could plausibly lie well above or below 0.82 and the run-to-run spread is not well characterized by three observations. Further seeds, and an explicit baseline measured under the same conditions, would be needed before drawing any comparative conclusion or treating the method as preferable on ANLI.
